title: Smoked Sausage Tagine
description: A Mexican twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine dish, featuring smoked sausage and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the potato, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and tagine spice mix. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
